desc: Paper Mario 64 partners in the battle's partner change: Goombella out, Goombario met. Mario's Tactics, Change Partner: the list has Goombella (out: taken) and right after her Goombario (his face, his name), Koops and Kooper. Down to Goombario, A: Goombella jumps back and Goombario comes out in her place (GSW 2012 now Goombario: the wheel's path), with his own moves on his turn. Shots: the ring, Tactics, the list, the cursor on Goombario, the change, his turn and moves
